blocks.text: Extracted places, era histories, corruption states, and production-facing visual briefs

Purpose. This atlas gathers places explicitly established in the Cyberpath Timeline and Stories, then adds clearly marked future-location proposals derived from those sources and from the game’s existing background framework. It is an inspiration and production reference. A proposed location is not automatically canon.

Authority. “Established” means the place or type appears directly in the source lore. “Expanded reconstruction” means the underlying place is established while visual and spatial details have been organized for future creation. “Proposed” means a new setting offered for later approval. Disputed, mythic, and uncertain histories remain uncertain.

Corruption. In this atlas, corruption is a production description, not a moral judgment. It may mean missing context, lost permissions, compression, restoration from mismatched versions, world-fold overlap, semantic mistranslation, repeated maintenance, or the game interface rendering a deeper Codex process as scenery.
